work.scope: Active recurrent rows, not padded physical GEMM work.

transfer.scope: Receiver fingerprint versus source. All transferred valid KV and hidden bytes.

lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

output.scope: Internal exact output sequence parity. Not original-HF fidelity or downstream accuracy.

state.scope: Exact hashes of recorded valid KV planes and prompt hidden state. Not original-HF accuracy.
